payload.title: Show linked procedure progress on living optimization reports
payload.description:
As an operator, I want a living optimization Report to show its linked Procedure Task summary and a plain-language run identity, so that I can understand what kind of run it is and what is happening without interpreting internal scope selectors.

Out of scope: changing Task lifecycle ownership, introducing new backend resources, or removing detailed scope evidence from the Report body.

Feature: Procedure-aware living Report header

Scenario: View a Report linked to a Procedure Task
Given a living optimization Report is linked to its Procedure Task
When an operator opens the Report
Then the page shows the standard Procedure Task visual summary
And the run type and lifecycle state are understandable at a glance
And raw scope selector syntax is not used as the primary subtitle or description

Scenario: View a Report without a linked Task
Given a Report has no linked Procedure Task
When an operator opens the Report
Then the Report remains readable
And the page does not show a broken Task summary

Scenario: Inspect exact scope
Given a living optimization Report has normalized scope evidence
When an operator needs execution details
Then the exact scope remains available in the Report evidence below the header
